description: Dispatch a human gig from an agent: a vetted human answers a VERIFY (fact-check a claim), VALIDATE (check an output), JUDGE (pick/compare), or FILL (supply missing data) task, and the answer comes back only after it clears independent human review — a VERIFIED result, not a raw crowd answer. The budget is escrow-held from prepaid credits at dispatch (402 = top up first with opentrain_create_credit_top_up) and captured only when review accepts the work; cancel before fulfillment to release the hold. Routing is automatic to the best-reputation available human. Requires jobs:write scope. Poll opentrain_get_gig_result for the verified answer.
name: opentrain_dispatch_gig
